newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-CRONJE PUTS TEAM IN DRIVER'S SEAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CRONJE PUTS TEAM IN DRIVER'S SEAT.

text.p: South African captain Hansie Cronje put his team in the driving seat by taking the prized wicket of Sachin Tendulkar on the first day of the third and final test against India at the Wanderers on Thursday.
Cronje had his opposite number snared by Brian McMillan at second slip in his first over and at tea India were struggling at 117 for three from 59 overs.
Tendulkar had threatened to wrest the initiative for his side after a painfully slow morning session had seen India crawl to 41 for one from 30 overs.
The little maestro had hit 35 from 55 balls with seven boundaries before he miscalculated an attempted drive and edged Cronje's fourth delivery into the safe hands of McMillan.
Tendulkar added 54 for the third wicket with Rahul Dravid who was still there at tea on 34, with Saurav Ganguly on five.
Earlier Nayan Mongia had fallen to an express delivery from Allan Donald which took middle stump after the opener had ground out 21 from 104 balls.
